setup: Fine-tuned (LoRA) on 8,000 PathVQA train Q&A pairs with base64 images (test-image near-duplicates removed by perceptual hash); reasoning_effort=none. A 3-epoch run (job uz7n7vzh, metrics in ft_metrics_qwen3p5-9b_e3.jsonl) overfit: eval loss 0.570 / 0.576 / 0.645 after epochs 1/2/3, so it was not deployed.
dataset: PathVQA (He et al. 2020) test, seeded 1,000-question subset via pathvqa_kit/scripts/eval.py --n 1000
prompt: shared system prompt (answer only; yes/no or 1-3 words), temperature 0, max_tokens 16
gpu_rate_note: Fireworks on-demand list price on 2026-11-02 (H100 $8/h, B200 $13/h); eval GPU minutes = wall time of the eval only
